help_shortcuts:
→ / ←: next / previous image
F1: help
F5: refresh
Esc: close this dialog
Ctrl+,: settings
Ctrl+O: open a source folder
help_behavior: A slot key adds or removes a copy. Source files are never changed. Modified copies require confirmation. On non-US layouts, press each key once so its label is learned; a dead key may briefly learn a composed character. Open the log folder from Settings → General.
empty: Ouvrir un dossier pour examiner les images.
empty_folder: Aucune image prise en charge dans ce dossier.
name_dialog_title: Choisir le nom du dossier de destination
name_spaces_dots: The name cannot contain only spaces or dots.
name_absolute: Enter a folder name, not an absolute path.
name_separator: Folder names cannot contain path separators.
name_character: The name contains a character that is not allowed.
name_trailing: The name cannot end with a space or dot.
name_reserved: This name is reserved by Windows.
name_duplicate: Another slot already uses this destination name.

defaults: Continuer avec les valeurs par défaut
help_text:
Right / Left: next / previous image
F5: refresh the image list
Slot keys: toggle a byte-identical copy in that destination
The source images are never changed. Slot labels are learned from the active layout.
partial_settings_save_failed: Les paramètres globaux sont enregistrés, mais pas les emplacements du profil. Vérifiez-les puis réessayez.
